title: How AI Blocks works: an expert layer on top of AI agents
seoTitle: How AI Blocks works: experts on top of AI agents
description: General AI gives average work. See how AI Blocks adds an expert layer: free base agents, trained experts, and the best agent for each part of a job.
lede: General AI agents tend to give the most common answer, which is rarely the best one. This guide explains how AI Blocks adds an expert layer on top: free base agents anyone can change, experts who train them, and a coordinator we are building that gives each part of a job to the agent best at it.
